sjkpSpotlight.title: Housing Credit Guarantee Scheme (SJKP i-Biaya)
sjkpSpotlight.desc: Self-employed? Grab/Foodpanda rider? E-hailing driver? Stall owner? Do not let the lack of payslips or EPF statements stop you from owning a home. Under SJKP, the Government of Malaysia guarantees your financing up to RM500,000 with a margin of 100% + 20% (MRTT/Legal)!
sjkpSpotlight.feat1Desc: 6 months bank statements & e-wallet sales proof accepted.
sjkpSpotlight.feat2Desc: 100% full loan without needing large cash savings.
sjkpSpotlight.feat3Desc: New, sub-sale, or auction properties are eligible.
sjkpSpotlight.note: *Managed fully digitally through MLTF branches nationwide.

process.title: 5 Simple Steps to Getting Your House Keys
process.subtitle: From online registration to key handover, MLTF financing specialists guide you at every step.
process.step1Desc: Fill out a quick form in 2 minutes with MyKad details and estimated income.
process.step2Desc: Upload bank statements, payslips, or gig income summaries right from your phone.
process.step3Desc: MLTF automated credit scoring system issues a Conditional Letter of Offer.
process.step4Desc: Accept the offer digitally or visit panel solicitors and the nearest MLTF branch.
process.step5Desc: Financing is disbursed to the developer/seller and you are ready to move in!

documents.title: Required Documents by Category
documents.subtitle: Select your employment category to view the required supporting documents.
documents.sjkpNotice: Special SJKP Scheme: You do not need an employer payslip or official EPF contribution statement!
documents.gigDoc1: Copy of Identity Card (MyKad) of applicant & spouse (if applicable)
documents.gigDoc2: Latest 6 months Bank Account Transaction Statements
documents.gigDoc3: Gig platform earnings summary (Grab, Foodpanda, Shopee, Lalamove etc.)
documents.gigDoc4: Income verification letter from Village Head / JKKK (Optional)
documents.gigDoc5: Copy of Property Booking Receipt or Draft Sale & Purchase Agreement
documents.gigDoc6: LHDN tax payment record (Form B / e-B) if available
documents.salariedDoc2: Latest 3 Months Payslips (6 months if with allowance/commission)
documents.salariedDoc3: Latest 3 Months Salary Crediting Bank Account Statements
documents.salariedDoc5: EA Form / Income Tax Statement e-BE
documents.salariedDoc6: Copy of Sale & Purchase Agreement (SPA) / Developer Booking Offer
documents.businessDoc2: SSM Business Registration Certificate (Form A/B & D)
documents.businessDoc3: Latest 6 Months Company / Personal Current Account Statements
documents.businessDoc4: LHDN Income Tax Form (Form B) & Tax Payment Receipts
documents.businessDoc6: Property Booking Document / Sale & Purchase Agreement
documents.helpPrompt: Have questions about your documents? Our officers are ready to assist with a free initial check.

kyc.pageSubtitle: Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) e-KYC Compliance Standard for Housing Financing

kyc.pdpaCheck: I consent to the collection, processing, biometric facial matching, and storage of my personal data pursuant to the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA) for housing financing evaluation.

kyc.stepFinalize: Submitting to National Identity Verification System...
kyc.successSubtitle: Your identity has been verified and your housing loan application is ready to proceed.
kyc.inReviewSubtitle: Our verification team is reviewing your documents manually to ensure accuracy. This usually takes 1-2 hours.
kyc.inReviewNote: You will receive an SMS and email notification once review is complete. You can continue exploring your dashboard.
